name: v2-tool-change
review: At 80 XYZ steps/mm and 100 extruder steps/mm, the three moves require X steps +800, +800 and -1600; T0, T1 and T0 route one 100-step extrusion to the corresponding configured motor, ending at (0,0,0,200,100). The source waits for an empty conveyor when selecting a different extruder, consistent with zero entry and exit speed for each move. At 100 mm/s^2, continuous zero-to-zero triangular profiles give 0.63246, 0.63246 and 0.89443 s versus 0.62968, 0.62968 and 0.89061 s recorded, within 0.44%. The five-actuator host simulator reproduced this case; it does not validate physical tool changes or extrusion.
